name: apigen run — Live server from source
description: Start a live MCP/HTTP/CLI server from a TypeScript source file. Supports multiple output plugins (mcp, api-fastify, api-express, cli) and transport types (stdio, SSE, streaming-http). Uses either v1 pipeline or v2 unified orchestrator (--v2 flag). Imports the source module via tsx, builds live function tables, and hands them to the selected plugin's run() method. Handles SIGINT/SIGTERM via AbortController for graceful shutdown.

Usage: apigen run [options]

Options:
  --source <path>     Path to TypeScript source file
  --type <plugin-id>  Output target
  --export <mode>     Export mode: "default" | "<named-object-name>" | omit for named exports
  --tsconfig <path>   Explicit tsconfig.json; default resolves the nearest config or a builtin one
  --namespace <name>  Package namespace/id (default: tsconfig folder name, else source folder)
  --opt <key=value>   Plugin option (repeatable). Projection overrides: http.verb.<id>=GET (default: [])
  --use <plugin>      Layer/mount/envelope plugin to activate (repeatable; accepts package specifier or local path) (default: [])

name: apigen generate — Generate artifacts to disk
description: Extract TypeScript source exports and generate artifacts to disk using the selected output plugin. Emits resolution scaffolding (package.json, tsconfig.json) for generated output to run from any directory. Patches generated package.json with per-surface logical-type deps (e.g., decimal.js when Decimal format detected). Supports both v1 and v2 orchestration paths.

name: apigen serve — Multi-source, multi-language server front
description: Mount many source files (TypeScript, Python) behind a single HTTP/1.1 + gRPC (HTTP/2) front server. Spawns child 'apigen run' subprocesses for each source, supervises them with readiness probes and health aggregation. Implements the SPEC §13 mixed-host serve topology with partial availability (a dead child fails only its own routes). Uses raw net.Server that peeks the first bytes of each connection to route HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2 prior-knowledge (h2c) gRPC traffic on the same port. Full orphan-free teardown with SIGTERM → SIGKILL escalation. Python interpreter pre-provisioned via @adhd/apigen-python-env (BUG-APIGEN-016 fixed).
verified_output:
Usage: apigen serve [options]

Mount many sources/languages behind one HTTP/gRPC front

Options:
  --source <path>      Source file to mount (repeatable; .ts → api-fastify, .py → py-flask) (default: [])
  --port <port>        Front HTTP/gRPC port
  --mount <ns=plugin>  Pin a namespace to an explicit plugin (repeatable; use py-grpc for gRPC) (default: [])
  -h, --help           display help for command
signature_note: A small distributed system in one command: protocol-peeking raw net.Server demuxes HTTP/1.1 vs h2c gRPC on same port; HTTP/2 client session caching with 60s idle eviction; partial-availability health model (each host isolated, aggregate /_meta/health); orphan-free teardown with SIGTERM→SIGKILL escalation; Python venv pre-provisioning avoids cold-start timeout. Implements SPEC §13/§13.1.

name: Output plugin architecture
description: Pluggable output targets registered at CLI startup. Each plugin implements OutputPlugin interface with generate() and optionally run() methods. Registered plugins: mcp, jsonschema, api-fastify, api-express, cli (aliased as cli-output), py-flask, py-grpc. Plugins may declare a language ('ts' or 'py') to control extraction path (non-TS plugins bypass TS compilation entirely).

name: --use plugin loading system
description: Load layer/mount/envelope plugins via --use flag. Resolution order: built-in slugs (health, logger) → package specifier or local path via dynamic import. Built-in plugins are statically imported so they inline in the bundled CLI. Loaded plugins are threaded to the run plugin via options.usePlugins for layer composition (BUG-APIGEN-009/010).
signature_note: Three-tier resolution (built-in → package → local path) with fallback candidate detection (default export, named 'plugin' export, or any object with 'capabilities' field).

name: v2 unified orchestrator
description: Unified detect→extract→merge→collision-check→generate/run pipeline. Activated via --v2 flag. Uses @adhd/apigen-core-client extract() with shared ExtractionSession (one ts-morph Project per tsconfig). Runs collision check per SPEC §5 uniqueness invariant. Builds per-source ComposedSchemas for backward compatibility with v1 plugin surface.
signature_note: PERF-APIGEN-001: single ExtractionSession per run (threaded through extractSource → generateSchemas, disposed in finally); eliminates duplicate ts-morph Project creation and lib.d.ts parsing. Collision check is a hard extract-time error (not silent last-writer-wins).

name: v1 pipeline backward compatibility
description: Legacy generate pipeline (default path without --v2). Uses runPipeline(): resolve-tsconfig → generateSchemas → composeSchemas. Still the default behavior for both run and generate commands. Present for backward compatibility.

name: Resolution scaffolding for generated output

Idempotent (never clobbers existing files).

name: Per-surface dependency manifest (DESIGN §14.1)
description: Collect logical-type dependencies from extracted schemas and patch the generated package.json. Recursively walks JSON-Schema nodes for 'format' annotations, maps format strings to npm packages via tsDepMap() from @adhd/apigen-base-logical. A surface using Decimal gets decimal.js^10 in its generated package.json. No blanket dep list — minimal per-surface.

name: Precondition guards (dod.fail-fast)
description: Three precondition guards that fail early with actionable messages: (a) assertFnsNonEmpty — 0-function source throws '0 functions found' with hint about generated output vs source; (b) assertDecimalLibPresent — functions using Decimal format check decimal.js is resolvable, otherwise 'install decimal.js'; (c) non-TS plugin bypass — prevents ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION crash when using --type py-flask with .py source.
signature_note: BUG-APIGEN-004: guards prevent cryptic ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND crash from empty function tables. assertDecimalLibPresent uses injectable resolver for testability (absent/present simulation).

name: TypeScript config resolution
description: Resolve tsconfig.json for schema generation. Precedence: explicit --tsconfig path → nearest tsconfig.json walking up from source → builtin default (default-tsconfig.json asset or in-memory fallback). Builtin path is memoized to prevent mkdtemp leak in long-running processes.
signature_note: Memoization in builtinTsconfigPath() fixes the 'one mkdtemp per call' leak that would spray temp directories in long-running serve/watch processes. Built-in default-tsconfig.json asset shipped beside CJS bundle.

name: CLI logging system (pino-based)
description: Program-level logging options added to every CLI command. Flags: --log-level (trace|debug|info|warn|error|fatal|silent), --log-format (json|pretty), --log-file <path>. All have env var fallbacks (APIGEN_LOG_LEVEL, APIGEN_LOG_FORMAT, APIGEN_LOG_FILE). Logs to stderr (never stdout) to keep stdout protocol-clean for MCP stdio transport. Uses @adhd/apigen-engine-runtime createLogger().

name: Multi-protocol front server (HTTP/1.1 + gRPC/h2c)
description: The serve command creates a front server that multiplexes HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 prior-knowledge (h2c) gRPC on a single TCP port. Uses raw net.Server that peeks the first 3 bytes (PRI for h2, otherwise HTTP/1.1) and routes to the appropriate handler. HTTP-handled hosts are proxied via node:http; gRPC hosts via node:http2 h2c client sessions with 60s idle eviction and unref() to not hold the event loop open.
signature_note: gRPC protocol requirements: te:trailers header forwarding (Python grpcio mandates it), grpc-status/grpc-message trailer extraction from END_STREAM-initial-headers fast-path, grpc reflection routing to first alive gRPC host. Protocol demux via socket.read(3) + socket.unshift() (paused mode, not flowing) for correct data replay to native HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 parsers.

name: Aggregate health model with partial availability (SPEC §13.1)
description: Aggregate _meta/health endpoint returning per-host status (ready|down) and overall status (ok|degraded). A down/failed host fails only its own routes (503 HTTP, UNAVAILABLE gRPC) while every other host continues serving. Children are supervised with exit handling that flips alive/ready flags. Front server stays up even when children die.
signature_note: gRPC UNAVAILABLE status 14 constructed manually via trailing headers (gRPC always uses HTTP 200); gRPC reflection routed to first alive gRPC host. Downgrade detection: gRPC hosts reached over HTTP/1.1 return 426 Upgrade Required. Partial availability is NOT whole-surface failure.

name: Python host integration (pre-provisioned venv)
description: Python hosts (py-flask, py-grpc) are spawned as child apigen run subprocesses. Before spawning, the managed Python interpreter is pre-provisioned via @adhd/apigen-python-env with optional grpc extras. APIGEN_PYTHON env var pins the interpreter for children. First-time venv bootstrap (pip install) happens before per-host ready timeout (BUG-APIGEN-016 fix).
signature_note: BUG-APIGEN-016: pre-provisioning avoids cold-start timeout for first-time pip install. User-supplied APIGEN_PYTHON is respected; one set by a previous startServe in same process is not treated as a user override (ensures ensures extras are unioned).

name: Projection-override config (Tenet 1)
description: Out-of-source projection-override mechanism. --opt http.verb.<id>=GET pairs override the HTTP verb per operation. apigen.config.json file provides baseline, CLI overrides win. Overrides are consumed at generate/run time and never written back to source (Tenet 1 invariant).

name: Export mode selection (named/default/named-object)
description: Select export mode via --export flag. Values: (omitted) → named exports, 'default' → default export, '<name>' → named object (e.g., 'myApi'). Resolved to ExportMode type for both v1 and v2 pipelines.

name: Dynamic TypeScript import via tsx
description: Dynamically import a TypeScript source file using tsx ESM loader. Registers the tsx loader for the duration of the import, then unregisters. Handles both in-repo (tsx available) and standalone (vitest) environments. Optional tsconfig path passed through to tsx.

name: Orphan-free process teardown with escalation
description: serve command ensures all spawned child processes are killed on shutdown. killAll() sends SIGTERM to all live children, then escalates to SIGKILL after 3s grace. Also destroys all gRPC h2c sessions. Idempotent (guards against double-close). Also tracks via _managedPython so interpreter is not left behind.
